title: Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program Withdrawal Notice Length by Plan
content:
The notice period of a withdrawal notice under the Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program runs for the length the notice-length schedule sets for the plan, in calendar days:

| Plan, with a withdrawal notice on file | Notice period |
|---|---|
| a plan of two program days per week: Creek Kids Club After-School Care (2 Days) | 7 calendar days |
| a plan of three program days per week: Creek Kids Club After-School Care (3 Days) | 10 calendar days |
| every other plan: Before-School Care (5 Days), After-School Care (5 Days), Before & After-School Care (5 Days), Pre-K Wraparound Care (5 Days) | the program's withdrawal notice period, 14 calendar days |

A withdrawal notice is on file when the enrollment has a withdrawal notice request that is received or completed.

## Examples (hypothetical, notice counted from day 0)

| Plan | Notice period | Last day of the notice period |
|---|---|---|
| After-School Care (2 Days) | 7 | day 7 |
| After-School Care (3 Days) | 10 | day 10 |
| After-School Care (5 Days) | 14 | day 14 |
